Name: Volume & Launcher
Author: Stan
Description: Volume dials for the game that is open and for any app (with a media screen), and keys that start, minimize and close games and apps with their logo and playtime. Games are found automatically via Steam, Epic, Xbox and Lunar Client.

Actions.Name: Game Volume
Actions.Tooltip: Dial for the volume of the game that is open right now, or of one game you choose, with its name and logo. Turn: volume. Click, double-click, triple-click and hold: mute, minimize/open, close or favorite volume (your choice).

Actions.Name: App Volume
Actions.Tooltip: Dial for the volume of one app, such as Discord or Chrome. When the app plays something it shows title, picture, play/pause and a timeline. Turn: volume, pressed turn: seek 5 seconds. Click, double-click, triple-click and hold: your choice.

Actions.Name: Game Key
Actions.Tooltip: Key with the logo, name and playtime of the game that is open, or of one game you choose. Click: start, minimize or show. Hold 1 second: close.

Actions.Name: App Key
Actions.Tooltip: Key for one app: its icon and name, or while it plays, the picture, title and timeline. Click, double-click and hold each do what you choose: minimize/open, play/pause, next, previous, mute or close.
